    # Setup: WCS at bottom center of stock, stock is just the part itself
    # The pocket floor is at z=30, top of part at z=50
    # Set WCS at bottom of part (z=0)
    setup_name = mb.create_setup(
        body_index=0,
        wcs_origin="bottom center",
        stock={"mode": "relative", "side_mm": 0, "top_mm": 0, "bottom_mm": 0},
        name="Pocket_Mill"
    )
    print(f"Setup created: {setup_name['setup']}")
    
    # Now add roughing operation - adaptive2d pocket milling with 10mm endmill
    # Pocket geometry: face 5 is the pocket floor at z=30
    # We need to select the faces that define the pocket boundaries
    # Face 5 (pocket floor, area=3578.54 at z=30) + the vertical walls around it
    
    # First let's use contour strategy targeting the pocket faces
    # For pocket2d we need the faces to machine
    rough_result = mb.add_operation(
        "Pocket_Mill",
        strategy="adaptive2d",
        tool=4,  # 10mm carbide endmill
        stepover_mm=7.5,     # 75% of tool diameter - good for adaptive
        stepdown_mm=5.0,     # Half depth per pass (10mm total depth)
        feeds={
            "cutting_mm_min": 3000,  # ~1m/s * 4 flutes / (1 tooth load) -> ~3000 mm/min
            "plunge_mm_min": 500,   # Conservative plunge for carbide
            "ramp_mm_min": 800,     # Ramp feed
            "spindle_rpm": 6000     # ~955 m/min surface speed for 10mm carbide
        },
        geometry={
            "faces": [5],  # pocket floor face
            "type": "pocket"
        },
        heights={
            "clearance_mm": 5.0,
            "retract_mm": 3.0
        },
        name="Pocket_Rough_Adaptive"
    )
    print(f"Roughing op created: {rough_result['operation']}")
